VI.description: Stand-in for an FPGA FIFO Write node with the handshake interface (FIFO In\2C Element\2C Input Valid -> Ready for Input\2C FIFO Out) so that a VI using it can be round-tripped through AIXML. The FIFO's configuration is given as constants on the diagram\3A FIFO Name (the FIFO item in the LabVIEW project\2C e.g. TS-Filter.Command) and Data Type (the element type\2C e.g. orderbook.command.ctl); Element is a Variant so one VI serves every element type (wire the element through To Variant). On My Computer it only passes FIFO In to FIFO Out and reports Ready for Input = TRUE. In the FPGA VI\2C replace each call with the real FIFO Method Node for FIFO Name and delete the constants.

FreeLabel.comment: Stand-in for FPGA FIFO Write (handshake). Configuration is the FIFO Name / Data Type constants wired by the caller.
